name: Kurosu Moe
source:
A food writer specializing in Akihabara who explores the town through its food.
Originally a general-interest reporter, she became fascinated with Akihabara’s subculture about three years ago. She now introduces everything from long-established restaurants to the latest trendy cafes and unique eateries from her own perspective.
While her casual outfits are accessorized to match her style, her tough, tomboyish personality is reflected in her beloved, rough and ready jeep.

[From in-game profile]
